name: Malaysia prohibited, restricted and danger areas
nameZh: 马来西亚禁区、限制区和危险区

layers.label: Airport traffic zone — authorisation required
layers.summary: 5 NM (9.26 km) around the aerodrome reference point: flying an unmanned aircraft here needs CAAM authorisation (MCAR 2016 reg. 140(1)(b); CAAM Safety Information 11/2022). Not an outright ban.

layers.label: Prohibited area (P), approximate boundary
layers.summary: Potential prohibited area: boundary reconstructed from the CAAM ENR 5.1 description and a coastline or border dataset, not an official CAAM polygon. Verify with current CAAM information.

layers.label: Restricted area (R), approximate boundary
layers.summary: Potential restricted area: boundary reconstructed from the CAAM ENR 5.1 description and a coastline or border dataset, not an official CAAM polygon. Verify with current CAAM information.

layers.label: Danger area (D), approximate boundary
layers.summary: Potential danger area: boundary reconstructed from the CAAM ENR 5.1 description and a coastline or border dataset, not an official CAAM polygon. Verify with current CAAM information.

layers.label: Prohibited area (P)
layers.summary: Prohibited area (ENR 5.1): flight of aircraft is not permitted at any time.

layers.label: Restricted area (R)
layers.summary: Restricted area (ENR 5.1): flight is allowed only if the published conditions are met. Read the times and conditions.

layers.label: Danger area (D)
layers.summary: Danger area (ENR 5.1): activities dangerous to aircraft may exist at the published times. Caution; check the conditions.

source.authority: Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia (CAAM), AIP Malaysia ENR 5.1
source.extraction: scripts/airspace/my-enr51.mjs (parses the published tabulation; see exceptions.json for what was not converted)

approximation.secondaryDataset: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (coastline and Malaysia/Thailand border shape only)

aerodromeTrafficZones.rule: CAAM Safety Information 11/2022 (11 Aug 2022), MCAR 2016 reg. 140(1)(b)

licenseNote: Derived from the public CAAM eAIP. No copyright or reuse terms were found on the eAIP site (checked GEN 0.1, the edition index and the cover pages on 2026-11-24); published on the owner's authorization of 2026-11-24 as planning reference, with the geometry reconstructed independently from the published coordinates. Approximate layers (approx-*) are reconstructions, not CAAM polygons; the coastline/border shape in them is from OpenStreetMap (ODbL, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors). Partial coverage: unconverted areas are listed in exceptions.json. Remove this region (or set publish to false) if CAAM asks. Aerodrome traffic zones: 5 NM circles centred on the aerodrome positions published in AIP Malaysia AD 2.2 and AD 4.1 (same unknown licence status).
